boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-purchase ways to gather, make, browse, study, and explore on Grand Valley’s Allendale campus.

cards.title: Meet people at Campus Life Night
cards.subtitle: Lot H1 · Allendale campus
cards.notes: Drop by the organization and campus-department tables, play the offered games, and use the event to compare ways to get involved.
cards.short_summary: A free, student-facing evening of tables, activities, and campus connections.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists Campus Life Night on August 30, 2026 as offering free activities, games, and free items at Valley Campus Lot H1.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Sunday, August 30, 2026, 6–8 p.m.; listed for students at Allendale Campus, Lot H1.

cards.title: Gather at Rainbow Social
cards.subtitle: Kirkhof East Lawn by Zumberge Pond · Valley Campus
cards.notes: Stop by the lawn event to connect with campus and community resources, enjoy the scheduled entertainment, and meet other Lakers.
cards.short_summary: A free resource-and-community social on the lawn beside Zumberge Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU describes Rainbow Social as a free event for students, faculty, and staff with food, entertainment, and campus and community resources.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Wednesday, September 2, 2026, noon–3 p.m.; for GVSU students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Play yard games at the cookout and carnival
cards.subtitle: GVSU Rec Field 1 by Laker Village
cards.notes: Join the listed yard games or ultimate frisbee, or simply use the open hangout time to meet people around Rec Field 1.
cards.short_summary: A student event combining games, snacks, and casual conversation at a named recreation field.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s event calendar lists the CM Free Cookout and Carnival at Rec Field 1 with yard games, ultimate frisbee, snacks, and drinks.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Saturday, August 29, 2026, 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; listed for students.

cards.title: Walk the Allendale campus with an ASAP mentor group
cards.subtitle: Starts in the Kirkhof Center Lobby · Allendale campus
cards.notes: Follow the mentor group through Kirkhof and nearby resource centers, then ask for help locating offices or class buildings along the route.
cards.short_summary: A guided campus walk focused on finding resources and getting oriented.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s 2026 ASAP Welcome schedule lists a Walking Allendale Campus Tour starting in the Kirkhof Center Lobby and states ASAP Welcome is free to all students.
cards.source_title: 2026 Asian Student Achievement Program Welcome Schedule
cards.access_notes: Scheduled August 27, 2026, 1–2:30 p.m.; ASAP Welcome is free to all students.

cards.title: Join the climate education summit
cards.subtitle: Russel H. Kirkhof Center · Valley Campus
cards.notes: Register for the in-person summit session and use the interdisciplinary program as a low-key way to learn and meet campus partners.
cards.short_summary: A free annual climate-education gathering with an Allendale session and online programming.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that registration for the 2026 Climate Change Education Solutions Summit is free and open to everyone, with an in-person session in Kirkhof Center.
cards.source_title: CCESS2026: Ways of Knowing in Climate Change Education
cards.access_notes: Runs October 14–15, 2026; registration is required and in-person capacity is limited.

cards.title: Make something at Creation Station
cards.subtitle: Kirkhof Center 1110 · Allendale campus
cards.notes: Use the in-room paper, markers, scissors, glue, and Cricut cutter for a casual group-making session; keep supplies in the room.
cards.short_summary: A named Kirkhof craft spot with free materials for on-site use.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s Reignite 2026 guide says Creation Station in Kirkhof 1110 provides construction paper, poster board, markers, scissors, glue, and other supplies for free.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–6 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; supplies may not leave the room without approval.

cards.title: Browse the Black Book Exchange Box
cards.subtitle: Mary Idema Pew Library entrance facing Cook Carillon Tower
cards.notes: Choose a book from the miniature library, then return it there or at another Black Book Exchange Box after you finish reading.
cards.short_summary: A free, community-facing miniature library for books about Black people and culture.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU reports that the Allendale Black Book Exchange Box is open to anyone in the community and offers free books about Black people and culture.
cards.source_title: Library collaborates with Grand Rapids nonprofit to host Black book exchange
cards.access_notes: Located near the Mary Idema Pew Library entrance facing the Cook Carillon Tower; the source says it is open to anyone in the community.

cards.title: Take an Art at GVSU self-guided tour
cards.subtitle: Allendale campus collection locations
cards.notes: Use the Art at GVSU app’s mapped tours to pick an outdoor sculpture or building route, then pause together at a few works.
cards.short_summary: A phone-based, self-guided route through the university’s art collection.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU says the free Art at GVSU mobile app provides self-guided tours with Google Maps implementation and a list of artworks in university buildings.
cards.access_notes: Requires a compatible phone and the free Art at GVSU mobile app; artwork locations vary by tour.

cards.title: Settle into the library study spaces
cards.subtitle: Intersection of Campus Drive and West Campus Drive · Allendale campus
cards.notes: Meet at the library, choose an available study space, and use the time for a quiet catch-up, reading session, or collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A named Allendale library with study space available whenever it is open.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that study spaces at Mary Idema Pew Library are available whenever the library is open and that visitors can obtain a free parking permit from Public Safety.
cards.access_notes: Study spaces are available whenever the library is open. Visitors need a permit for non-visitor parking spaces; the library page says Public Safety offers a free visitor permit with photo ID and license plate number.

cards.title: See an exhibition at PAC Gallery
cards.subtitle: PAC 1121, Haas Center for Performing Arts · Allendale campus
cards.notes: Check the exhibition page before heading over, then walk through the gallery together and spend time discussing one work each.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gallery with free public admission during posted exhibition hours.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that admission to the GVSU Art Gallery in PAC 1121 is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited gallery page lists PAC 1121 in the Haas Center for Performing Arts and free public admission; confirm the current exhibition and hours before visiting.
